title: Compact FlowTrace rows and selected-node detail panel changes

open-flowtrace-view.label: M.open initializes the compact tree viewer state
open-flowtrace-view.summary: Changed: opening a trace seeds state.selected_id with the artifact root, creates the tree split, and redraws; redraw now also ensures a separate detail split exists when enabled.

view-defaults.label: State carries compact view defaults
view-defaults.summary: Changed: state.config.view defaults the Neovim viewer to compact rows with the inline detail panel enabled, while preserving existing agent provider state.

setup-view-options.label: setup merges optional view configuration
setup-view-options.summary: Changed: require('flowtrace').setup({ view = ... }) now deep-merges compact and detail_panel options before any agent setup handling, letting users opt out of compact rows or hide the panel by default.

readme-docs.label: README documents the compact view and D toggle
readme-docs.symbol: Default keys in the FlowTrace tree
readme-docs.anchor: Default keys in the FlowTrace tree:
readme-docs.summary: Changed: the docs now explain that the selected-node detail panel is a separate split that stays visible while long compact trees scroll.

redraw-with-view-options.label: redraw passes view mode and selected node into tree.render
redraw-with-view-options.summary: Changed: redraw now renders only the scrollable tree buffer, passes detail_panel=false to avoid inline details, restores the cursor, and then refreshes the separate selected-node detail panel.

selected-id.label: selected_id resolves the node for the detail panel
selected-id.summary: Changed: the helper maps the current tree cursor row through state.index and falls back to the remembered selected id or flow root, keeping panel content tied to navigation.

render-entry.label: tree.render chooses compact or verbose rendering
render-entry.summary: Changed: render still accepts opts and can produce compact or verbose tree rows; the main Neovim flow now disables inline detail rendering because details live in a separate split.

compact-node.label: add_compact_node writes one row per flow node
compact-node.anchor: local function add_compact_node(lines, index, highlights, flow, expanded, id, prefix, is_last, branch_label, seen)
compact-node.summary: Changed: the compact renderer combines connector, expansion marker, optional branch label, file location, cleaned label, kind badge, collapsed child counts, and repeat guard into a single indexed row with targeted highlights.

children-for.label: children_for normalizes children and branch targets
children-for.summary: Changed: child and branch collection was factored into one helper so compact and verbose renderers traverse the same ordered tree shape.

child-summary.label: child_summary reports collapsed subtree size
child-summary.summary: Changed: compact rows and detail lines can show step and branch counts, giving users some scale even when a subtree is collapsed or only the selected-node panel is visible.

detail-panel.label: add_detail_panel appends selected-node details below the tree
detail-panel.anchor: local function add_detail_panel(lines, index, highlights, id, node)
detail-panel.summary: Changed: render_detail formats just the selected-node details for the dedicated detail buffer, reusing add_detail_lines so the summary can stay visible while the tree scrolls independently.

verbose-node.label: add_verbose_node preserves the old expanded metadata layout
verbose-node.anchor: local function add_verbose_node(lines, index, highlights, flow, expanded, id, prefix, is_last, branch_label, seen)
verbose-node.summary: Changed: the former add_node implementation remains available as add_verbose_node for users who disable compact mode via setup config.

cursor-autocmd.label: CursorMoved keeps the detail panel synced
cursor-autocmd.summary: Changed: the FlowTrace buffer registers a CursorMoved autocmd that updates state.selected_id from the row index and refreshes only the detail split, avoiding a full tree redraw on every cursor move.

branches.label: press D to hide or show the detail split
press o to collapse or expand and preserve cursor

toggle-detail-panel.label: D toggles the separate detail panel
toggle-detail-panel.summary: Changed: the D key flips state.config.view.detail_panel, closes the separate detail window when hiding it, or lets redraw recreate the split when showing it again.

toggle-expand.label: o expand/collapse now redraws without moving the cursor
toggle-expand.summary: Changed: the existing expansion toggle now calls redraw(true), preserving cursor position while the compact tree and detail panel are regenerated.

ensure-detail-window.label: ensure_detail_window creates a persistent detail split
ensure-detail-window.summary: Changed: the detail panel is now a real Neovim split below the tree. The helper reuses an existing detail window or calls window.open_detail_buffer when the panel is enabled and missing.

redraw-detail.label: redraw_detail updates only the selected-node panel
redraw-detail.summary: Changed: selected-node updates render detail lines into the detail buffer without rewriting the tree, so the tree scroll position is independent from the sticky summary panel.

open-detail-buffer.label: open_detail_buffer splits the left FlowTrace column
open-detail-buffer.summary: Changed: the window module can create a small nofile flowtrace-detail split below the tree window, with wrapping enabled and cursorline disabled for a read-only details panel.
